findings.title: CREATOR_NAV/ORCHESTRATOR_NAV duplicated between settings fixture and surfaces.tsx
findings.note: QC1 S-001. Studio fixture data drift risk; extract shared helper.
findings.closure_note: Extracted CREATOR_NAV/ORCHESTRATOR_NAV to apps/design-studio/src/fixtures/shell-nav-data.ts; both surfaces.tsx and settings-host-fixtures.tsx import from the single source.

findings.title: Verify error helper does not distinguish transport failure vs no-match
findings.note: QC2 S-001. Spec-locked copy either way; distinguish in future.
findings.closure_note: Added 'no-match' AgentVerifyStatus; AgentPicker shows 'No matching agent for this command.' (scan reached daemon, no agent matched) vs 'Could not reach this agent.' (transport failure). Both hosts map ok=false to no-match, catch to error.

findings.title: AgentPicker re-renders entire card grid on verifyStatus change
findings.note: QC3 W-001. Negligible at 2-6 cards; React.memo if grid grows.
findings.closure_note: Wrapped AgentCard in React.memo; stabilized onSelect via ref pattern in AgentPicker so verifyStatus changes no longer trigger card re-renders.

findings.title: useVerifyAgent mutation lacks unmount cancellation
findings.note: QC3 W-002. Local daemon scan <100ms; minimal risk.
findings.closure_note: Added AbortController to useVerifyAgent with useEffect cleanup on unmount; stale scan results after unmount throw AbortError instead of settling.

findings.title: Selection-sync useEffect fires on every node interaction (not just selection changes) — latent perf trap
findings.note: QC3 W-001. Acceptable at author-scale; derive from onNodesChange in future.
findings.closure_note: Selection sync now guards on selected entity id change only; pure position drag no longer triggers inspector rebind.

findings.title: Graph<->list toggle unmounts CanvasShell, losing RF viewport state
findings.note: QC3 S-002. Acceptable for P0 (deterministic layout); CSS visibility toggle when drag/auto-layout lands.
findings.closure_note: use-canvas-viewport.ts hook preserves pan/zoom across graph↔list toggle; viewport restored on re-mount.

findings.title: CanvasShell fully mocked in orchestrator tests — no real RF integration coverage
findings.note: QC3 S-003. jsdom lacks ResizeObserver; E2E test needed in follow-up.
findings.closure_note: Real RF integration harness under canvas test utilities; ≥1 Outline orchestrator test uses real ReactFlow with ResizeObserver polyfill.
